entradas.text: “The first months had positive indicators but the delay of the infrastructure project reversed economic gains.”
Everyone stood up as I entered the room, buttoning their suit jackets.
“That is discouraging. We've done the best we could thus far.”
entradas.menu: “That is discouraging. We've done the best we could thus far.”

entradas.text: “Many leaders on the Business Council have praised the logistical improvements.”
“I'm confident we will turn this mood around with adaptive projects and solutions.”
entradas.menu: “I'm confident we will turn this mood around with adaptive projects and solutions.”

entradas.text: “We can do much more to improve the economy and we will because our work is far from over.”
entradas.menu: “We can do much more to improve the economy and we will because our work is far from over.”

entradas.text: “On a side note, consumer spending has decreased further due to a pessimistic mood caused by our economic issues.”
“The success of the first infrastructure project is already showing a positive effect on the economy.”
“The Business Council is satisfied with this infrastructure improvement.”
“Positive results show that we are on the right path towards economic growth.”
entradas.menu: “Positive results show that we are on the right path towards economic growth.”

entradas.text: “Our trade deal with Agnolia has increased our imports and exports by 50% in one month, with much more to be expected in the future.”
“The National Business Council isn't happy with the lack of tangible economic improvements at all.”
“I expected a better performance from all of us. Our first investment was meant to be a good first step in the overall plan.”
entradas.menu: “I expected a better performance from all of us. Our first investment was meant to be a good first step in the overall plan.”

entradas.text: “Focusing on future investments is better as more opportunities are surely on the horizon.”
entradas.menu: “Focusing on future investments is better as more opportunities are surely on the horizon.”

entradas.text: “Good. Just as expected.”
entradas.menu: “Good. Just as expected.”

entradas.text: “That shows our capability as the administration to bring prosperity.”
entradas.menu: “That shows our capability.”

entradas.text: “Excellent news. I hope to hear more of it.”
entradas.menu: “Excellent news.”

entradas.text: “I'm confident that we can do much more than what we have accomplished thus far.”
“While I agree that our first attempts were not successful, we still might have economic opportunities left.”
“We are close to getting high economic growth rates. We should be willing to cooperate on new projects.”
“It isn't good for our reputation. The people expected quick solutions. We are running out of time.”
Mikail started grinning as he leaned forward.
Mikail started grinning as he leaned forward.
Mikail frowned and put his fingers on his chin.
Symon checked his large dossier.
The team gathered in Holsord at the Ministry of Economy to go over the current economic situation.
“Thanks to the highway, economic growth is returning to Agnland. We are expecting new investments and jobs in the region.”
“Thanks to the high-speed railway our two most important cities are linked faster. We are expecting quick economic growth in Greater Holsord and Gelsland.”
“Why couldn't we solve the H-3 Highway construction issues?”
“Let's make sure that it won't be unfair.”
“Certain individuals will be held accountable for their failures. ”
entradas.menu: “Certain individuals will be held accountable for their failures. ”

entradas.text: “If the budget allows it.”
“Surely there is still a way to finish what we have begun.”
“From my perspective, we need a bigger cash injection into the economy.”
“Agreed. Any reliance on credit could endanger our future.”
“We need to fix the issues... Not punish people.”
The building was constructed in 1892 by Heron Walt, possibly the most famous architect in Sordland. It was a simple and elegant structure with a few of his signature domes spread out over the roof.
“Why couldn't we solve the L-1 High-speed rail construction issues?”
“I actually agree with you. Lileas had a very prominent role.”
“We should maintain our optimism.”
“Good to hear. We will do better.”
“I am not so sure about that. But time will tell. I still see it as risky. Our support for their military operation was questionable.”
“On a side note, consumer spending has increased due to the optimistic mood caused by our economic successes.”
“I support our foreign initiatives with partners as democratic as Agnolia.”
“I must say, I still can't get behind a trade deal with Wehlen, especially when it involved a military cooperation.”
“Increased trade has improved our economy. I see this as a reason for celebration.”
“We should see our improved relations with Agnolia as a stepping stone to expand positive influence.”
“We need to keep working hard.”
“Good to hear. We will do better.”
“The people are already speaking of the positive turn.”
“You are correct.”
“I can see the reactions in society.”
“The subjects of tax reform and many more await future debate.”
“Your efforts are noted. Everyone who has contributed is greatly appreciated.”
entradas.menu: “Your efforts are noted. Everyone who has contributed is greatly appreciated.”

entradas.text: “Never ever have I seen one person accomplish what many could together.”
“Teamwork makes the dream work.”
“It was a gargantuan effort from our side in the Ministry of Economy.”
I walked through the large bronze doors. Two assistants led me upstairs to a meeting room.
“Welcome, Mr. President.”
“Please take your seats.”
entradas.menu: “Please take your seats.”

entradas.text: “It's good to be here.”
entradas.menu: “It's good to be here.”

entradas.text: “Let's begin.”
entradas.menu: “Let's begin.”

entradas.text: Everyone took their seats.
“As you all know, today we'll go over our economic status.”
“We should look for more trade partners. We can make much more and increase our presence in the region.”
entradas.menu: “We should look for more trade partners. We can make much more and increase our presence in the region.”

entradas.text: “I'm glad our efforts are finally bearing fruit.”
entradas.menu: “I'm glad our efforts are finally bearing fruit.”

entradas.text: “Just as we thought.”
“Exactly. Good work, Mr. President.”
“I agree. Not just the region -- we should aim for more deals internationally.”
“That's beside the point.”
entradas.menu: “That's beside the point.”

entradas.text: “I agree. Aligning ourselves with more democratic countries is good for Sordland.”
entradas.menu: “I agree. Aligning ourselves with more democratic countries is good for Sordland.”

entradas.text: “It is good for overall trade with other countries as well. Democratic countries generate more trust in general.”
Edith didn't reply, but she smiled.
“Our trade deal with Wehlen has increased our imports and exports by 60% in one month, which is a considerably good number.”
“This was a dangerous gamble. I'm glad it's started paying off.”
entradas.menu: “This was a dangerous gamble. I'm glad it's started paying off.”

entradas.text: “It was a good idea to align with Wehlen.”
entradas.menu: “It was a good idea to align with Wehlen.”

entradas.text: “Perfect.”
entradas.menu: “Perfect.”

entradas.text: “Mhm.”
“The payoff is high, yes. But so is the risk. Our support for their military operation was questionable.”
“Regardless, the numbers are clear.”
“I feel like we have made a contract with the devil.”
“What is done is done.”
entradas.menu: “What is done is done.”

entradas.text: “I didn't ask you for your opinion.”
entradas.menu: “I didn't ask you for your opinion.”

entradas.text: “We are reaping the benefits. We will come out on top here.”
entradas.menu: “We are reaping the benefits. We will come out on top here.”

entradas.text: “I hope this was the right decision.”
entradas.menu: “I hope this was the right decision.”

entradas.text: “There is certainly no use deliberating that decision *now*.”
“Albeit risky, it is lucrative.”
“I am not only worried about Wehlen. It's the other countries too.”
“Deivid, do you have the stats on our deal with Agnolia?”
“We are sorry, Mr. President.”
“Unfortunate, really.”
Deivid took a sip from his tea.
“We should've prepared better for the deal.”
entradas.menu: “We should've prepared better for the deal.”

entradas.text: “The responsibility falls on me.”
entradas.menu: “The responsibility falls on me.”

entradas.text: “We don't need other countries. Sordland is enough for itself.”
entradas.menu: “We don't need other countries. Sordland is enough for itself.”

entradas.text: “Perhaps. But, we could've used the economy boost.”
“Our trade with other countries increased slightly below our expected growth rate due to the failed negotiations.”
“Don't blame yourself.”
“Some good news. We currently have a budget surplus.”
“That means we can pursue many investments which would drive our economy upwards. I will present you with the draft documents of economic expansion soon.”
“I'd rather spend the money elsewhere.”
entradas.menu: “I'd rather spend the money elsewhere.”

entradas.text: “That's excellent news.”
entradas.menu: “That's excellent news.”

entradas.text: “Very well. I will take a look.”
entradas.menu: “Very well. I will take a look.”

entradas.text: “That is certainly one of the options.”
“I agree. With the extra money there is much more we can do.”
“Thank you.”
“Sadly, our budget reserves don't look good.”
“We will need to look into whatever we can to increase the budget we have.”
“What can we do about it?”
entradas.menu: “What can we do about it?”

entradas.text: “That's unfortunate.”
entradas.menu: “That's unfortunate.”

entradas.text: “I will formulate a plan and present you with the next steps.”
“As per the latest data from the ministry, you will be glad to hear that we are on the right track to end the recession.”
“As per the latest data from the ministry, the recession unfortunately seems to be lingering still in some economic areas.”
“No matter the cost, we will have to increase our economic development rates. Otherwise, I am sad to say that we will be doomed.”
“Unless anything changes, of course.”
“We need to celebrate.”
entradas.menu: “We need to celebrate.”

entradas.text: “Great work. Keep it up.”
entradas.menu: “Great work. Keep it up.”

entradas.text: “Who knows what will happen in the following months?”
entradas.menu: “Who knows what will happen in the following months?”

entradas.text: “I'm afraid it's still a bit too early for a celebration.”
“I personally will celebrate once we are completely out of it.”
“Thank you, Mr. President.”
“Exactly, but no use worrying.”
“We will cross that bridge when we get to it.”
“If we are unable to stop this recession, we are heading towards an economic catastrophe that has never been seen before in Sordland.”
“We need to use the opportunities we have been given. Trade deals and infrastructure improvements always help.”
“Mr. President. I will be very clear.”
Symon took off his glasses and put them on the table. He looked at me straight in the eye.
“You already know this, and I don't want to frighten you, but...”
“I can't even begin to imagine how we could survive that. None of us wants to see Sordish people starve while the state is unable to provide for its citizens.”
“No, in all of Eastern Merkopa.”
“Don't worry. We will end the recession. I promise.”
entradas.menu: “Don't worry. We will end the recession. I promise.”

entradas.text: “As you said, none of us want that.”
entradas.menu: “As you said, none of us want that.”

entradas.text: “Then we need to get to work.”
entradas.menu: “Then we need to get to work.”

entradas.text: “Exactly.”
“I hope you are right.”
He put on his glasses.
“There are a few methods we can use to tackle the recession.”
“Our surplus is a great reason to spend extra on a new investment project to push for further economic development in the future.”
“We have the potential to take on additional debt to flatten the downward turn of the economy.”
“There are two main distinctions between these projects. It's either about continuing our infrastructure improvements or investing in increasing production.”
“If we continue working on our infrastructure, that would lift us up to advanced country levels. However, our industrial production also needs a boost to return to pre-recession levels.”
“I have prepared a few project proposals.”
“The plans for these projects will be finalized soon. For now, I can provide preliminary information. Which one would you like to hear first?”
“I don't want to take the risk. Let's move on.”
entradas.menu: “I don't want to take the risk. Let's move on.”

entradas.text: “I have enough information.”
entradas.menu: “I have enough information.”

entradas.text: “Economic growth in Benfi could be propelled. It still has yet to reach its full potential.”
entradas.menu: “Economic growth in Benfi could be propelled. It still has yet to reach its full potential.”

entradas.text: “Benfi is rapidly developing and there is much to gain from increasing its connectivity to the world.”
“Imagine all the tourists that would arrive.”
“We must focus on improving the well-being of our worst citizens and while Morna is no poor city it very well deserves investment.”
“I don't think investing in Morna with a port would do much to change our economic prospects. Goods are flowing from other places just as fast.”
“For infrastructure we have two projects. One is the Benfi International Airport and the other is the Morna Port.”
“Increased imports and exports on a more accessible path to Holsord is very lucrative in my opinion. Time is money.”
“The Morna port will boost trade and improve the flow of goods towards Holsord, because the Conriat port is too small in capacity and extension is blocked by the navy headquarters.”
“Morna would be a more significant city with a port and the advanced logistical connection to Holsord would be better utilised.”
entradas.menu: “Morna would be a more significant city with a port and the advanced logistical connection to Holsord would be better utilised.”

entradas.text: “Benfi is growing at a rapid pace and would benefit highly from a international airport. Much more money to be made there too.”
“I agree with Edith. The Morna port will mean a great deal to our trade and improve the economy of the Lorren region too.”
“What are the projects that could improve our infrastructure?”
entradas.menu: “What are the projects that could improve our infrastructure?”

entradas.text: “What are the projects that could boost our production?”
entradas.menu: “What are the projects that could boost our production?”

entradas.text: “The recession has hit the farmers of Sarna particularly hard. Besides the agricultural output increase would boost our economy.”
“The investment won't be able to recover the industry there. Conriat on the other hand would bring more financial gain.”
“Our government has the opportunity to support agriculture and we should take it. It would increase our exports too.”
“Conriat is a developing city with a lot of potential while Sarna and the Bergia region are lacklustre.”
“For production we have two projects. One is the Sarna Agricultural Zone and the other is the Conriat Industrial City.”
“We should invest and develop Conriat to diversify the economy in Greater Holsord which would mean a great deal.”
“Manufacturing investments are the kind of investments we need for a healthy economy and our currency strength.”
“The Conriat Industrial City project has the potential to increase manufacturing in the Greater Holsord Region by a large amount.”
“Sarna is a much poorer city indeed. It deserves any investment it can get from the government.”
entradas.menu: “Sarna is a much poorer city indeed. It deserves any investment it can get from the government.”

entradas.text: “I see the Sarna Agricultural Zone investment as a higher priority due to the fact that farmers in Bergia were the most hit by the recession. Sarna also is a much poorer city than Conriat.”
“Conriat could benefit from a larger manufacturing industry. It would bring the city to a position where it could rival Lachaven.”
entradas.menu: “Conriat could benefit from a larger manufacturing industry. It would bring the city to a position where it could rival Lachaven.”

entradas.text: “There is of course the option to not take any risks related to our budget.”
“Very well.”
“That covers our subjects for today.”
“Edith, how strong is our currency?”
entradas.menu: “Edith, how strong is our currency?”

entradas.text: “Mikail, how is the mood at the National Business Council?”
entradas.menu: “Mikail, how is the mood at the National Business Council?”

entradas.text: “Anybody who wants to add something?”
entradas.menu: “Anybody who wants to add something?”

entradas.text: “Deivid, what can we expect in terms of our trade situation?”
entradas.menu: “Deivid, what can we expect in terms of our trade situation?”

entradas.text: Nobody answered.
“This has caused some imports and exports to drop, and has led to concern in global trade circles."
“That concludes the meeting. Have a good day, all.”
“Currency health has greatly improved thanks to the strong economic action of the administration and the value of the Ren has also increased beyond expectations.”
“The business leaders in the council are satisfied with the economic growth and have reported that they are willing to increase investments.”
“Our success in reaching a trade deal has boosted our position as a regional trade route and increased the likelihood of potential trade partners.”
“We can observe a five percentage point drop in inflation at the Central Bank in comparison to pre-election levels. This is unprecedented when analyzing in the past five years.”
“New hires, branch openings and new expansions of several more optimistic corporations are happening as we speak.”
“We have imported and exported more across the board with all countries -- except Rumburg.”
“I have a couple more economy related questions.”
entradas.menu: “I have a couple of more economy related questions.”

entradas.text: “I know enough now. Thank you for the information.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you for the information.”

entradas.text: “They are holding on to their investments until they feel it is safe to invest their reserves in new hires or branches.”
The meeting ended.
“See you soon.”
“The business leaders in the council are nervous about the lack of tangible economic improvements in the country.”
“Unfortunately, our inability to reach a trade deal has hurt our position among our regional partners."
“Until next time, Mr. President.”
“Goodbye.”
“Currency health and economic output improved the Sordish Ren post-elections but due to the recent developments our currency value decreased.”
“There are observable losses at the Central Bank. When we compare pre-election levels, we see that inflation has increased by ten percentage points.”
“Let's hear the stats on our deal with Wehlen.”
“The devil? Wiktor Smolak is not a bad man.”
entradas.menu: “The devil? Wiktor Smolak is not a bad man.”

entradas.text: “He's destroying his own people... But if you say so, Mr. President.”
“Our trade deal with Agnolia has increased our imports and exports by 25% in one month with much more to be expected in the future.”
“But higher prices of Agnolian steel didn't result in a trade surplus.”
“We should look for more trade partners. We can make much more and increase our presence in the region.”
entradas.menu: “We should look for more trade partners. We can make much more and increase our presence in the region.”

entradas.text: “That's what we expected.”
entradas.menu: “That's what we expected.”

entradas.text: “That doesn't seem like a positive indicator.”
entradas.menu: “That doesn't seem like a positive indicator.”

entradas.text: “We agreed to higher prices, Mr. President. This is what we expected. But regardless of the surplus, they are an important partner to have.”
“We should see our improved relations with Agnolia as a stepping stone to expand positive influence.”
“That's true. Regardless of the surplus, Agnolia is an important partner to have.”
“I agree. Not just the region, we should target for more deals internationally.”
“Let's begin without any further ado.”
“The ongoing trade war between Arcasia and United Contana has disrupted global trade immensely.”
“We are doing whatever we can to mitigate the fallout from 'Black Tuesday'.”
“Our net losses are growing as a fallout, and we have lost a substantial amount of budget.”
“Unfortunately, we couldn't escape the effects either.”
“Deivid?”
“There are no signs that either side is backing down for now.”
“That's unfortunate. But on the bright side, we're not the only country in this state.”
“Rumburg was hit especially hard.”
“Good news for us. It will give us an edge over them.”
entradas.menu: “Good news for us. It will give us an edge over them.”

entradas.text: “When will the effects on Sordland wane?”
entradas.menu: “When will the effects on Sordland wane?”

entradas.text: “Do whatever you can to make sure Sordish citizens do not suffer more from this.”
entradas.menu: “Do whatever you can to make sure Sordish citizens do not suffer more from this.”

entradas.text: “There is always a silver lining.”
“We are doing everything we can to mitigate the disaster. The end of the tunnel is in sight, Mr. President.”
“How are we doing in terms of our infrastructure?”
“How are we doing in terms of our trade?”
“It will be costly to get back on our feet, Mr. President. I don't know how to say this, but...”
“Whatever we do, we need more budget. That's the bottom line. We need to squeeze out every single Sordish Ren we can to survive this.”
“Like dominoes, of course, this will also affect the election.”
“We need to stay at the top however we can.”
entradas.menu: “We need to stay at the top however we can.”

entradas.text: “You are exaggerating. We will overcome this regardless. We survived so far.”
entradas.menu: “You are exaggerating. We will overcome this regardless. We survived so far.”

entradas.text: “I will do whatever I can to bring us that budget. Even if that's the last thing I do.”
entradas.menu: “I will do whatever I can to bring us that budget. Even if that's the last thing I do.”

entradas.text: “Otherwise... our country might be in a state to declare bankruptcy.”
“Yes, and we need to fix this situation in order to do that.”
“I'm sure Mr. Galade would agree.”
“We haven't experienced a crash this bad since the last days of the Kingdom.”
“We need to do our due diligence.”
“Thank you, Mr. President.”
“The aid we have received from Arcasia has helped us tremendously.”
“Personally I think it was a great decision, Mr. President.”
“We will use the majority of the capital to combat the recession.”
“I would expect nothing less from our Arcasian friends.”
entradas.menu: “I would expect nothing less from our Arcasian friends.”

entradas.text: “Let's hope this decision won't come back to haunt us later on.”
entradas.menu: “Let's hope this decision won't come back to haunt us later on.”

entradas.text: “I had to do whatever it took to end the recession. Even if it meant a deal with Arcasia.”
entradas.menu: “I had to do whatever it took to end the recession. Even if it meant a deal with Arcasia.”

entradas.text: “The aid we have received from United Contana has helped us a lot.”
“Although I heard some rumors.”
“I would expect nothing less from our United Contanan friends.”
entradas.menu: “I would expect nothing less from our United Contanan friends.”

entradas.text: “Regardless of what they think, the capital will certainly be handy.”
“I had to do whatever it took to end the recession. Even if it meant a deal with United Contana.”
entradas.menu: “I had to do whatever it took to end the recession. Even if it meant a deal with United Contana.”

entradas.text: “Let's hope this decision won't come back to haunt us later on.”
entradas.menu: “Let's hope this decision won't come back to haunt us later on.”

entradas.text: “There were many people who opposed this decision. Especially in the Lotherberg Group.”
“We now have another weapon to combat the recession.”
“I don't think that will be the case. Arcasians are known for their fair business.”
“I don't think anyone in the room is questioning your decision, Mr. President.”
“Well said!”
“I sure do hope so as well.”
“Sometimes we need to make sacrifices. I think everyone in this room understands that, Mr. President.”
“If you say so, Mr. President.”
“Our debt situation is awfully bad, and I heavily advise against further expenditures. However, I will still present new projects and leave the decision to you, Mr. President.”
“The good news is that the government has a perfectly balanced budget.”
“We have the potential to take on additional debt to maintain the upward trend of the economy.”
“The important factor is that we don't take excessive debt going into the future.”
“If we stabilize our crumbling infrastructure it would support some growth later. However, our industrial production also needs a boost to return to pre-recession levels.”
“There are two main distinctions between these projects. It's either we improve our poor infrastructure or we invest in increasing production.”
"Currency health and economic output degraded significantly and nearly crashed the Sordish Ren. Our currency is on the course to actually crash if we don't act."

“Catastrophic losses in our financial strength are observed at the Central Bank. Especially compared to pre-election levels, inflation has increased by twenty percentage points year on year this quarter.”
“We have enough of a budget to survive this crisis for some time. In order to navigate the financial repercussions of Black Tuesday, we must act in a fiscally liberal manner.”
“Furthermore, the recent 'Black Tuesday' event caused dramatic economic upheavals in Sordland and the wider region.”
“The Central Bank has begun working on a bill with the Grand National Assembly to increase our preparedness for future damaging economic incidents.”
“I am looking forward to further collaboration between our departments to solve upcoming issues.”
“The NBC will also lend support to the analysis and contingency plans regarding the ongoing developments.”
“The issues surrounding the energy prices and the imbalance they cause in the market are also of pressing concern. Average citizens and businesses are suffering.”

“After the Central Bank Reinforcement Act, our focus will shift to primarily tackle the energy inflation crisis in the country. We will present a bill about this in the near future if the situation regresses.”
“We are tackling these with measures we have in our power at the C.B. to stabilize the market.”
“Our treasury is in a dangerous amount of debt.”
“If we don't reduce our debt in the future we might fall in a debt crisis or worse.”
“What are you suggestions on tackling this?”
entradas.menu: “What are you suggestions on tackling this?”

entradas.text: “I have to stop spending.”
entradas.menu: “I have to stop spending.”

entradas.text: “I will work on some proposals regarding taxes to generate further revenues.”
“Maybe we should be more cautious with the treasury.”
entradas.menu: “Maybe we should be more cautious with the treasury.”

entradas.text: “Furthermore, the recent 'Trade War' has caused dramatic economic upheavals in the wider region and Sordland.”
“If we don't invest our resources when the country needs it, our future might be in a state of uncertainty.”
“Rizia's Gasom co-investment has boosted our position in the region, but our failure to sign a significant trade deal with our neighbors has raised concerns.”
“This has caused some imports and exports to drop."
